name: theorem-workbench
description: Local-first evidence receipts for AI agents: exact computation, refutation, replay, and benchmark artifacts.

scripts.docker:check: docker compose run --rm theorem npm run check
scripts.docker:cli: docker compose run --rm theorem npm run cli --
scripts.docker:proof: docker compose run --rm theorem npm run proof:launch
scripts.demo: npm run cli -- ask "for all integers n, n^2+n+1 is even"
scripts.demo:parity: npm run cli -- ask "for all integers n, n^2+n is even"
scripts.demo:replay: npm run cli -- ask "for all integers n, n^2+n+1 is even" -- --out receipts/false-parity.json && npm run cli -- replay receipts/false-parity.json
scripts.demo:render: npm run cli -- render receipts/false-parity.json markdown receipts/false-parity.md && npm run cli -- render receipts/false-parity.json html receipts/false-parity.html
scripts.proof:launch: npm run demo:replay && npm run demo:render && npm run demo:parity && npm run demo:bench && npm run demo:physics && npm run demo:numeric && npm run demo:symbolic && npm run demo:check
